game.name: Naruto Shippuden : Ultimate Ninja Storm 2 (USA)
game.desc: Naruto Shippuden: Ultimate Ninja Storm 2 is a fighting game for Xbox 360 that covers the entire Shippuden period of the original manga. A very complete Adventure mode allows you to relive the most impressive battles, staged in a striking way with lots of QTE. Playable online, the title features no less than 40 characters and benefits from a truly supercharged combat system.
